canonical_statement: Let M be an oriented smooth n-manifold with boundary and let omega be a smooth compactly supported differential (n-1)-form on M. With the outward-normal-first induced orientation on the boundary and boundary inclusion i, the integral over M of the exterior derivative d omega equals the integral over the boundary of the pullback i^* omega.

excluded_degenerate_cases: Empty boundary is included and should reduce the right side to zero. Noncompact M is included only through compact support of omega. Manifolds with corners, singular chains, piecewise-smooth domains, vector-field divergence formulations, and complex contour formulations are outside this root. The n = 0 encoding must be decided explicitly because the informal degree n-1 is not a natural-number index.
